name: Weekly AR review
tagline: Chase overdue invoices, then check the drafts before they go out next week.
description: Each Monday I scan for overdue invoices and draft chase emails (using the Chase late payments workflow). Then I park the drafts for you to review on Tuesday. Anything you OK goes out; anything you reject I'll re-draft.

week_of.description: ISO date (the Monday of the week)

phases.name: Review chase drafts
phases.human_instructions: Open the chase emails in your drafts folder, look them over, and approve when you're happy. If anything looks off, reject and tell me why — I'll re-draft.
